sources.rationale: Two copper layers at nominal 70 µm each. 1.6 mm FR4, 0.16 mm minimum trace/space, 0.254 mm PTH annulus and 20% trace-width tolerance. Source-backed native footprint annuli were checked before routing.
F.Cu and B.Cu 0.07 mm each; FR4 core 1.44 mm and solder mask 0.01 mm per side. This requests 2 oz copper; it is not a measured finished stackup.

External 1.5 ohm resistor bench pulse draws 2.90 A at 4.35 V for 1000 ms. Illustrative auxiliary 1 A at 5 V/80% efficiency totals 4.337 A before buzzer and tolerances. Camera current and thermal performance are not measured.

Two copper layers at nominal 70 µm each. 1.6 mm FR4, 0.16 mm minimum trace/space, 0.254 mm PTH annulus and 20% trace-width tolerance. Source-backed native footprint annuli were checked before routing.
F.Cu and B.Cu 0.07 mm each; FR4 core 1.44 mm and solder mask 0.01 mm per side. This requests 2 oz copper; it is not a measured finished stackup.

External 1.5 ohm resistor bench pulse draws 2.90 A at 4.35 V for 1000 ms. Illustrative auxiliary 1 A at 5 V/80% efficiency totals 4.337 A before buzzer and tolerances. Camera current and thermal performance are not measured.

IPC-2221 external-layer estimate: k=0.048, DeltaT=10 C, I=4.5 A, t=2 oz requires about 1.196 mm. Nominal 1.5 mm at -20% width gives 1.2 mm. A 1.5 mm finished via with 18 µm average plating has about 0.0848 mm² barrel section, comparable to the minimum-width trace section 0.084 mm²; actual via temperature rise is unverified.
4.5 A is an illustrative design allowance for the reviewed bench scenario. It does not qualify maximum camera current, copper bottlenecks, enclosed temperature, connectors or wiring.

2.90 A at 2 oz and 10 C rise requires about 0.652 mm by the external IPC-2221 estimate. Selected 1.0 mm, or 0.8 mm after -20% width tolerance. The load remains external and the 1000 ms pulse unchanged; no initiator or flight qualification.
1 A at 2 oz and 10 C estimated rise needs about 0.150 mm. Selected 0.6 mm for margin and voltage drop; the auxiliary/camera 1 A budget remains an unmeasured assumption.
Selected 0.5 mm for the 3.3 V sensor/SD rail. Actual startup and SD-write load and MCU regulator thermal margin still require measurement.
